thread:
incident-bot: PAGING: P1 — customer=hawthorn (vpc-hawthorn-prod) observed elevated latency and 5xxs against model family x-large-1q; impact: degraded responses & API timeouts. Pager: oncall jess.

jess (oncall): ack — I'm looking. assigning SRE.

omar (sre): I see error spikes from the dedicated pool serving hawthorn: avg latency 950-1400ms last 6m, 5xx ~12%. KV cache miss rate ~67% on that pool.

mike-r (eng-runtime): that KV miss is suspicious — maybe corrupted prefix caching for pinned variant. Any recent model rollouts for that tenant?

leila (eng-ml): hawthorn was on x-large-1q:v2.0.2 (auto-rollout) yesterday at 03:14 UTC. There is a known compatibility regression with our new attention kernel on long-context in v2.0.2.

tara (acct): customer reported increased hallucinations plus "slow replies" via support ticket #HW-3219. They're on a reserved Dedicated plan and flagged compliance constraints — they want a controlled mitigation, not a transparent model swap.

nina (support-ops): told them we're investigating and will update in 15m.

mike-r (eng-runtime): plan proposal: 1) pin hawthorn to x-large-1q:v2.0.1 (safevariant) immediately (no model rollback global) 2) enable safemode fallback to x-large-1q:stable-1 for any degraded responses 3) throttle burst concurrency for tenant to 50% until cache warms 4) run canary 5% traffic to v2.0.1 for 10m then expand. Anyone object?

omar (sre): +1. We need a quick KV cache flush on that pool after pin. I'll run graceful cache invalidate for tenant keys.

jess (oncall): go for pin. Omar, after invalidate, watch tail of logs and metrics for 10m. Mike, can you prepare the pin command?

mike-r (eng-runtime): executing pin via console API now. Command: 
```
POST /admin/tenants/hawthorn/model_pin
{ "model": "x-large-1q", "version": "v2.0.1", "strategy": "immediate" }
```
Response: 202 accepted — rollout queued to dedicated pool.

leila (eng-ml): I'll enable safemode ruleset for hawthorn: 
```
ruleset.hawthorn.safemode = true
ruleset.hawthorn.fallback = "x-large-1q:stable-1"
```
Confirming change pushed.

nina (support-ops): update to customer: "We've pinned your model to a safe variant and are monitoring. Expect improved behavior within 10-20 minutes. We'll follow up with a write-up."

tara (acct): thanks — please cc me on the external note.

omar (sre): cache invalidate done (cmd: infractl pool invalidate --pool hawthorn-dedicated --tenant hawthorn --prefix kv). Observability: miss rate dropping, latency trending down to ~420ms. 5xx down to 1.8%.

mike-r (eng-runtime): canary 5% to v2.0.1 started. No regressions in canary logs so far.

jess (oncall): good. I'll stay on until metrics stable. Next handoff in 30m -> omar will take primary.

sam (platform-ops): FYI I adjusted autoscale buffer for that dedicated pool (+2 GPUs) to avoid eviction during warmup, will revert after stable.

leila (eng-ml): quick QA check: ran sample prompts from the customer's failing set against v2.0.1 and stable-1 — v2.0.1 matches expected behavior and fewer hallucinations. Sending diff to thread.

tara (acct): customer acknowledged the update and appreciates the controlled approach. asking for RCA and timeline for root cause.

mike-r (eng-runtime): immediate mitigation complete. Action items: (1) full root cause RCA — eng-runtime + eng-ml (2) regression test to block v2.0.2 auto-rollout until patch (3) customer-facing RCA draft by EOD (tara + nina).

jess (oncall): handoff note: monitoring window 60m. omar will be primary after 30m. If we see 5xx >3% for 5m, escalate to eng-runtime and page pageresponse group.

omar (sre): acknowledged. I'll create a short runbook snippet for this tenant so future incidents can be quicker: pin -> cache invalidate -> adjust autoscale -> safemode.

incident-bot: Incident update: severity remains P1 while remediation is validated. Next automated check in 5m.

nina (support-ops): drafting customer status email now; will share for review.

tara (acct): I'll join review.

mike-r (eng-runtime): quick note — we should add a model rollout guard to prevent v2.0.2 from auto-propagating to dedicated pools until QA signoff. I'll open ticket RT-4421.

jess (oncall): thanks team. I'll post a short postmortem skeleton after incident stabilized. handing off in 28m to omar.

omar (sre): closing loop: metrics stable at 18:24 UTC, 5xx ~0.9%, latency ~380-460ms. Keep monitoring for next 2 hours.

nina (support-ops): sent status update to customer at 18:27 UTC.

incident-bot: INCIDENT NOTE: Handoff complete — jess -> omar. Severity downgraded to P2 for monitoring period.

jess (oncall): leaving handoff notes in #oncall-runbooks. Thanks all.

-- end of thread --
